expectation_gap.gap_definition: The SPY-carry prior treats theme-peers of negative-event and positive-event names as identically priced exposures, while the exp-20260807-001 forward read claimed negative-event theme-peers earn HIGHER ten-session SPY-excess than positive-event theme-peers. At the 655-row re-read (exp-20260815-001) that claim failed its own half-stability confirmation (older half reversed), so the live question at 1005 rows is whether the separation direction is time-stable at all; the monetization bars are reachable only behind that screen.

transmission.catalyst: A structured first-order news event with machine-recorded polarity joined through the deterministic entity-exposure map to listed theme-peers before the next session open.

candidates.why_not_arbitraged: The claim is a diffuse second-order cross-sectional rotation, not a first-order headline trade: peers are one join away from the news and the direction is inverted relative to naive sentiment reading. At the last read the effect was concentrated in the recent half of the sample and the gross magnitude sat below the two-leg cost bar, which is exactly why nobody monetizes it naively; this read allocates no capital and changes no order.
candidates.falsifier: The separation claim itself is killed (recorded as direction instability, not under-sizing) unless ALL five exp-20260807-001 confirmation bars pass on the frozen 2026-08-24 cohort: floors (negative rows >= 200, events >= 20, dates >= 10, positive rows >= 200); event-level negative > positive; row-level mean AND median negative > positive; event-level separation positive in BOTH chronological halves; no single negative event > 40% of summed positive per-event excess and no single ticker > 40% of row-level positive excess mass. Only if all five hold is the frozen pair-sleeve viability question asked: qualify ONLY if event-level separation (mean of per-event mean excess_10d, negative minus positive) > 100bp AND row-level pooled mean separation > 45bp, both unchanged from the 2026-08-08 re-park declaration with no cost-constant retune, no half-conditioned sub-verdicts, and no relation_type re-slices. Any fail re-parks the lane at the next +50%/+10 bar (>= 1508 closed negative-side rows) with scripts/build_reopen_readiness.py synced in the same ticket AFTER close; the tilt shape stays dead outcome-blind (1/0/0 executed-entry touches vs >= 5 per window, structurally uncovered) and no touch bar is re-read here.
